definitions.explanation: Indicates that a state or action continues without a break. Often used at the beginning of a sentence to signal that something ongoing will persist.
Indicates that something will happen after the current event or situation. Common in formal announcements, business communication, and news.

examples.japanese: {引|ひ}き{続|つづ}きご⟦{注意|ちゅうい}→注意：01464_chuui⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
{引|ひ}き{続|つづ}き⟦{調査|ちょうさ}→調査：03489_chousa⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{進|すす}めて→進める：01949_susumeru⟧まいります。
examples.english: We will continue to carry out the investigation.

examples.japanese: ⟦{来年|らいねん}→来年：00745_rainen⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧{引|ひ}き{続|つづ}き⟦よろしく→よろしく：01070_yoroshiku⟧⟦お{願|ねが}いいたします→お願いいたします：27603_onegaiitashimasu⟧。
examples.english: We look forward to your continued support next year as well.

examples.japanese: {引|ひ}き{続|つづ}き、⟦ニュース→ニュース：04437_nyuusu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧お⟦{伝|つた}え→伝える：01220_tsutaeru⟧⟦します→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: We will continue to bring you the news.

examples.japanese: ⟦{開会式|かいかいしき}→開会式：27306_kaikaishiki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{引|ひ}き{続|つづ}き、⟦{記念|きねん}→記念：00232_kinen⟧⟦パーティー→パーティー：02946_paatii⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{行|おこな}われた→行う：01238_okonau⟧。
examples.english: Following the opening ceremony, a commemorative party was held.

examples.japanese: ⟦{午前中|ごぜんちゅう}→午前中：11495_gozenchuu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{会議|かいぎ}→会議：00710_kaigi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{引|ひ}き{続|つづ}き、⟦{午後|ごご}→午後：00544_gogo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦ワークショップ→ワークショップ：06399_waakushoppu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{予定|よてい}→予定：00824_yotei⟧⟦されている→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Following the morning meeting, a workshop is scheduled for the afternoon.

notes:
USAGE:
Used both as an adverb modifying a verb (sense 1) and as a conjunctive expression connecting two events (sense 2). In sense 2, the pattern is often Noun ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{引|ひ}き{続|つづ}き (following Noun). Very common in formal and business contexts.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {引|ひ}き{続|つづ}き〜⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to continue doing
- 〜⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{引|ひ}き{続|つづ}き: following, subsequent to
- {引|ひ}き{続|つづ}き⟦よろしくお{願|ねが}いします→よろしくお願いします：23566_yoroshikuonegaishimasu⟧: set phrase for continued support

REGISTER:
Slightly formal. Frequently heard in news broadcasts, business emails, and official announcements. In casual speech, ⟦そのまま→そのまま：03322_sonomama⟧ or ⟦{続|つづ}け→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧て are more natural.
